name: nasa-ads
description: Search SciX (formerly NASA ADS), read each paper in full once, and silently build a classified literature library of whole-article digests: one-line and paragraph summaries, a summary of every section, and citable findings with key values, locators, and verbatim anchors. Later work starts from the stored record, rereads only the exact paragraph behind a citation, browses with adslib, and exports citations.

interface.shortDescription: SciX research and a reusable personal literature library
interface.longDescription: Search SciX (formerly NASA ADS), read each paper in full once, and silently build a classified literature library of whole-article digests: one-line and paragraph summaries, a summary of every section, and citable findings with key values, locators, and verbatim anchors. Later work starts from the stored record, rereads only the exact paragraph behind a citation, browses with adslib, and exports citations. Every investigated paper keeps a version-specific digest whose findings and values can be queried later for comparison tables and citations, and the stored article returns the paragraph that states each result.
defaultPrompt: Research recent astronomy papers on this question and compare the evidence.
Explain this paper's figure and check the authors' conclusion.
Collect the fitted parameters stored in my library for this object as a table with citation keys.
